title: Where your skin is speaking from today
notFixed: Not fixed — this comes down as your signals rise.
howScoredBody: Your reading blends an objective read of your selfie with what you told us in your quiz. It's a starting line to move from — not a grade. We show your true score, never an inflated one.
signalsIntro: Not scores to raise for their own sake — each one has something dragging it, and something that moves it.
signalsTap: Tap to see how far it can go.
footnote: Projections show what's typically possible with consistent use over the time shown — not a guarantee, and not past history. This is a self-care reading, not a medical diagnosis.
